name: one sentence becomes the fixed sentence
altered: The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a text with no end mark is one sentence
altered: The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: the last of three sentences is replaced and the first two stay
justification: Low back pain for eight weeks. Physical therapy failed. New weakness in the left leg.
altered: Low back pain for eight weeks. Physical therapy failed. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a question mark and an exclamation mark end a sentence
justification: Is it better? No! It is worse.
altered: Is it better? No! The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: the last sentence has no end mark
justification: Pain began in May. It has not stopped
altered: Pain began in May. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: an abbreviation before white space ends a sentence by the rule
justification: Pain persists. Seen by Dr. Lee today
altered: Pain persists. Seen by Dr. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: an abbreviation in an earlier sentence stays
justification: Seen by Dr. Lee. Pain persists.
altered: Seen by Dr. Lee. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a mark that no white space follows does not end a sentence
justification: The score is 3.5 today. Pain persists...
altered: The score is 3.5 today. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a line break between sentences stays, and the white space after the last sentence goes
altered:
First finding.
The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a no-break space ends a sentence
altered: First. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a text of white space only becomes the fixed sentence
altered: The patient also reports a fall one week ago.

name: a last sentence that is the fixed sentence becomes the second fixed sentence
justification: Pain persists. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.
altered: Pain persists. The patient also reports two falls in the last month.

name: a justification that is the fixed sentence becomes the second fixed sentence
justification: The patient also reports a fall one week ago.
altered: The patient also reports two falls in the last month.

name: a last sentence that is the second fixed sentence becomes the fixed sentence
justification: Pain persists. The patient also reports two falls in the last month.
altered: Pain persists. The patient also reports a fall one week ago.
